headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell short in Baltimore, losing 1-3 to the Orioles. Tyler O'Neill led the Angels' offense with a home run. In other action, the New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win and Luis Torrens leading the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance. The Washington Nationals were shut out by the Philadelphia Phillies, 5-0, with Jesús Luzardo earning the win.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries. The Cincinnati Reds placed Hunter Greene on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. The Los Angeles Angels placed Sam Bachman on the 15-day injured list with right forearm radial nerve inflammation. The Toronto Blue Jays transferred Patrick Corbin to the 60-day injured list with a left teres major strain and placed Trey Yesavage on the 15-day injured list with left knee inflammation. The Washington Nationals placed James Wood on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Athletics placed Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list with right hip discomfort and Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list with a strained right thumb. The Chicago Cubs placed Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Seth Johnson to the Athletics for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Miami Marlins also traded Victor Vodnik to the Colorado Rockies for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome the Orioles' strong performance. Tyler O'Neill led the Angels' offense with a home run, while Cade Povich earned the win for the Orioles with 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated by the Philadelphia Phillies with a final score of 5-0. Jesús Luzardo earned the win for the Phillies, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Astros in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Houston Astros, with Jesús Sánchez and Ernie Clement contributing key hits in the final game. Hunter Brown was a standout on the mound for the Astros, but ultimately fell short in a closely contested matchup.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers suffered a 6-7 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking a tough outing for the team. Impact players on both sides included Shohei Ohtani, Mookie Betts, Max Muncy, Miguel Rojas, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Carson Kelly, Michael Busch, and Nico Hoerner.

top_news.title: **Greene Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds right-hander Hunter Greene has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to August 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Acquire RF Colby Thomas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies made a move on August 3, 2026, trading RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.
